facts.fact: AICCRA states that Cote d'Ivoire's Ministry of Agriculture can now, for the first time, access seasonally updated satellite-based maps and forecasts of rice area and yield through the adapted RIICE tool.
AICCRA states that RIICE gives the ministry seasonally updated maps and forecasts of rice area and yields.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture (with AfricaRice, IRRI, Sarmap)

CIV.note: CNRA and AfricaRice did fieldwork on a rice tool; nothing on digital policy research.
Stakeholder consultations concerned adapting a rice tool, not a named digital law or policy.
